Mouse Brain Cell Type Explorer

A readable view of the whole adult mouse brain taxonomy from the Allen Brain Cell Atlas (Yao et al., Nature, 2023). Pick a class, then a subclass, to read its card with every supertype and cluster inside.

What each field means, from the atlas's annotation table

Data: Yao Z. et al., A high-resolution transcriptomic and spatial atlas of cell types in the whole mouse brain. Nature 624, 317-332 (2023). doi:10.1038/s41586-023-06812-z.

Tables: WMB-taxonomy release 20231215 of the Allen Brain Cell Atlas, including the annotation table cl.df_CCN202307220.xlsx. Region names from Allen-CCF-2020. The data are shared under the CC BY NC 4.0 licence.

Every value shown is copied from those tables. Totals are sums over the tables. Nothing here assigns a function to a cell type.
